entries.text: Accompanies Terah from Ur of the Chaldees to Haran Ge 11:31
Migrates with Abraham to the land of Canaan Ge 12:4
Returns with him to Beth-el Ge 13:1-3
Separates from Abraham, and locates in Sodom Ge 13:5-14
group: Rich in flocks, and herds, and servants

entries.text: Taken captive by Chedorlaomer; rescued by Abraham Ge 14:1-16
group: Rich in flocks, and herds, and servants

entries.text: Providentially saved from destruction in Sodom Ge 19; Lu 17:28,29
group: Rich in flocks, and herds, and servants

entries.text: Disobediently protests against going to the mountains, and chooses Zoar Ge 19:17-22
group: Rich in flocks, and herds, and servants

entries.text: His wife disobediently yearns after Sodom, and becomes a pillar of salt Ge 19:26; Lu 17:32
group: Rich in flocks, and herds, and servants

entries.text: Commits incest with his daughters Ge 19:30-38
group: Rich in flocks, and herds, and servants
